technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Company data

# Included processes
Included are the manufacture of single-silicon PV cells in China, supply of raw materials for perovskite semiconductor, glass, aluminium frame, working and packaging materials as well as waste disposal, transport and emissions of lead to air and water.
